[LIMP.3.1.5] An importer's request for `import a.b` does
**not** match a file at `<root>/a.b.ds` (the dot inside the
filename is treated as a literal dot, not a path separator).
The dotted form is exclusively a path-segment separator at
import resolution time. Filenames with embedded dots are not
valid library identifiers (consistent with [LIMP.7]'s
single-`NAME` library-name constraint per segment).
